title: Every call callback signed and processed once; inbound and outbound flows correct
goal: Make each provider callback count exactly once and make inbound and outbound calls follow the right steps.
why: CALL-AUTOMATION 3.2 and 4.4 items 2-4: callbacks have no idempotency (a repeated callback writes a second call record and another notification); inbound <Dial> has no action URL so the no-answer path is never reached; outbound never connects the agent; R107 added signatures.
steps: Tenant 0050 provider_events (provider, provider_call_id, event, sequence, received_at, PRIMARY KEY(provider, provider_call_id, event, sequence)). First statement of every callback: INSERT OR IGNORE; if no row inserted, return the empty provider response and stop. Confirm the sequence field name for the provider (Twilio SequenceNumber on status callbacks; for a provider without one use event + CallStatus + timestamp).
Notifications for missed calls deduped by call id (missed-call-handler.ts).
Inbound: <Dial action="/voip/twiml/dial-status" timeout=maxRingDuration> so no-answer/busy reaches voicemail and emits call.missed from the dial result (CALL-AUTOMATION 4.2 note).

Outbound: POST /calls/outbound uses provider.placeCall; mode from tenant call settings (softphone default outside India; bridge when R308 configures it); the call log keeps lead_id/contact_id from R119. No Plivo-specific routes (owner decision 2026-10-14).
tests: backend/test/voip-once.test.ts: each simulator scenario twice in a row produces one call_logs row, one notification, one task; dial-status no-answer leads to voicemail markup and call.missed once; outbound bridge sends the agent leg first (mock provider records order).
gate: cd backend && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failed files and passed >= the last merged count (1296 on 2026-10-14)
cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3110 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8797/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/calls.spec.ts
goLiveVerify: Provider retry behaviour on a real account.
notes: Before editing read: this batch file, docs/readiness/READINESS-PLAN.md sections 0 and the design note for this area, desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3-4 (executor rules, worktree bootstrap with node_modules junctions; never npm install inside a worktree unless the batch adds a dependency, and then only in the main checkout by the orchestrator).

Backend tests follow the existing pattern (see backend/test/voip-callbacks.test.ts): import env, createExecutionContext, waitOnExecutionContext, applyD1Migrations from cloudflare:test; applyD1Migrations(env.MASTER_DB, env.TEST_MIGRATIONS) in beforeAll; POST /api/v1/test/reset; call worker.fetch(request, env, ctx). isolatedStorage is false and singleWorker true, so use unique ids/emails per test file.

Read docs/decisions/ADR-001-voip.md (sections 4, 6, 7), its addendum when it exists (the owner could not sign up with Plivo; the addendum settles the default provider, likely Twilio where it can serve, with India handled separately), and docs/CALL-AUTOMATION.md (sections 2, 3, 4). Everything here stays behind the VoipProvider interface; do not design around Plivo. Calls are included in plans with a monthly minute cap (owner decision 2026-10-14).

Bulk seeding in tests or e2e (many leads, messages or payments) triggers automation recipes; set settings.automations_paused = true for that tenant first (PUT /api/v1/automations/pause or the setting row), then restore it.
